task_description: Construct a task-wide functional knowledge overlay for gene-perturbation expression prediction, covering the full fixed GEARS gene universe and used jointly for all Norman perturbations.

scope.knowledge_universe: Reusable human gene knowledge from selected source snapshots, with explicit cell-context qualifiers.
scope.screening_policy: Screen all graph genes. Report perturbation-target coverage separately. Apply each approved source/transformation policy across the universe; do not restrict the run to one perturbation or one functional module.

existing_knowledge: GEARS constructs its perturbation graph from gene-GO set Jaccard similarity and also uses a separate coexpression graph.
Keep the graph gene universe fixed; treat pathway/complex memberships, contextual attributes, and signed regulation as distinct knowledge types.
Measure overlap with existing GO and retain additional evidence/context explicitly.

source_candidates.name: Reactome
source_candidates.preferred_access: Bulk human pathway memberships and hierarchy; pin a release and checksum.

source_candidates.name: hu.MAP
source_candidates.preferred_access: Bulk complex memberships with source confidence classes.

source_candidates.name: ENCODE
source_candidates.preferred_access: K562 metadata queries and approved processed regulatory resources; preserve assay and mapping semantics.

source_candidates.name: PubMed
source_candidates.preferred_access: Task-wide topic queries; deduplicate papers by PMID/DOI, cache article text once, extract all supported statements with exact quotations and study provenance.

communication.style: Concise manifests and evidence summaries; keep large tables outside conversation context.

retrieval_budget.record_budget_scope: Literature-derived statement candidates; bulk database rows are not capped. One saved paper may support multiple statements across the full gene universe.

review_policy.audit_sampling: Stratify by source, mapping status, confidence, and knowledge category; combine seeded random samples with flagged cases.
review_policy.unresolved_policy: Quarantine unresolved records and report their counts.
